# Corrected explanation results (generated; do not edit by hand)

Research prototype only. Not clinically validated and not intended for diagnosis or patient care.

Generated by `scripts/59_xai_stats.py` at commit `4e91caa6e4` from `artifacts/logs/xai_v2/*_test.csv` (1,502 test images with lesion masks, 1,437 lesion groups). Rules: `reports/prereg_v5_client_asks.md` section 1. Supersedes the explanation rows of `reports/stageE_results.md` section 6 (kept as `legacy_frame`).

## Metric definitions (generated from the function docstrings)

- Overlap (mask recall): the share of the lesion covered by the top-20% most salient pixels.
- Precision: the share of the top-20% most salient pixels that fall inside the lesion.
- Pointing: 1 if the single most salient pixel falls inside the lesion, else 0.
- Centroid distance: between the centre of the top-20% region and the lesion centre, in image widths.

Offsets are in image widths. The recall ceiling is the mean of min(1, 0.2 / area); the precision ceiling the mean of min(1, area / 0.2). Pointing chance for random maps equals the mean mask area; for the centre-fixed Gaussian it is the share of masks containing the image centre.
